arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Layton argued the Court should maintain its prior precedent.
He stated legislators should determine the minimum age for capital punishment.
Mr. Waxman argued society's evolving standards of decency now draw the line.
He contended everyone agrees some age limit exists for juvenile executions.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the constitutional floor for juvenile criminal responsibility. It determines whether states can impose the ultimate penalty on adolescents. The outcome shapes national standards for criminal sentencing. It impacts how courts treat young offenders in capital cases.
